$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the photography pack composed with a Los Angeles portrait photographer's content seed (Wren Hollis), an ink brand, and the vitrine register. home.layout "stack" in the seed turns the home page into the photographer's stack — every sitting at one size, full bleed, on stone caption bands, closed by one line and a text link. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Portrait photographer
description: A portrait photographer's site in window light: one full-bleed stack of sittings, every frame the same size, each captioned on a thin stone band like a museum label, then one quiet line and a text link to book a sitting. Collections, client proofing galleries, and a live sitting calendar behind it — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's /book page and Manage calendar open on Wren's own sittings, not the base demo photographer's.

types.name: Portrait sitting
types.description: An afternoon in your own rooms or mine, by the best window we can find. One person, no lights, no hurry.

types.name: Couples & families
types.description: The same slow afternoon for two or more — partners, siblings, three generations at the kitchen table.

types.name: Short sitting
types.description: One hour in the studio's north window: a portrait for the book jacket, the program, or the mantel.

theme.$comment: The vitrine register's brand overlay: the preset's own ink accents as the project brand, so app surfaces wear the same stone-and-ink register as the marketing pages (the pages resolve brand over preset accent; identical values mean no shift). mode light opens on the stone ground — the base photographer opens dark, and theme merges shallowly. navigation re-pins the shared photographyShell chrome to the burger overlay: the wordmark alone over the stack, the links folded away.

landing.$comment: The vitrine register over the base's routes. pages replaces the base's skeletons wholesale, so all six routed pages are pinned: home is the stack (gallery sequence with a band captionStack, closed by the colophon banner); the rest keep the base's compositions.
